sources.snippet: The 'Baseline (Qwen3)' refers to the score of the standard Qwen3 model with reasoning enabled as an option. '+FineTuning' indicates the score after fine-tuning using 100 samples from the included dataset, combined with synthetically generated data created under the same conditions.
